messages:
carol: hi everyone :wave: i'm carol, started today. i can connect to Okta VPN but can't reach staging-api.redwood.internal — `curl` just times out. ssh to bastion.redwood.internal also hangs (`ssh carol@bastion.redwood.internal`). who should i ping for VPN/VPC access?

vpn-bot: Detected new device login for carol. Please approve MFA in Okta to complete VPN handshake. If you haven't, go to https://okta.redwood.com and approve the sign-in. :lock:

it-support: welcome carol! :tada: Quick checks — what's your VPN client (Okta VPN / Pulse / OpenVPN / WireGuard) and OS? Can you paste the output of `ip route` (mac: `netstat -rn` or `route -n`) and also try `curl -v http://staging-api.redwood.internal:8080/health`?

carol: macOS Ventura, using Okta+Pulse. i approved MFA. here's `netstat -rn` excerpt:
`default            192.168.1.1        UGScg           en0`
`10.25.0.0/16       10.8.0.1           UGScg           utun1`
`curl -v` still just hangs with TCP timeout.

marina: looks like split-tunnel behavior — traffic to 10.25.0.0/16 should go over utun1 (vpn). a quick test: `ping 10.25.10.5` (staging-api internal ip) and `ssh -v carol@bastion.redwood.internal` to get verbose ssh logs. if ping fails, run `traceroute 10.25.10.5` to see where packets go.

carol: `ping 10.25.10.5` -> `connect: Network is unreachable`. traceroute shows first hop as 192.168.1.1 (my home router). so seems split tunnel is sending internal traffic over local network.

it-support: yep that's the symptom. For Pulse on mac there's a setting 'Route all traffic through VPN' — enable that if your profile allows it. If not, you can add a temporary route on mac: `sudo route -n add -net 10.25.0.0/16 10.8.0.1` (replace `10.8.0.1` with your utun gateway). After that `ping`/`ssh` should go via the VPN.

marina: also check bastion ACLs — we only allow ssh from the internal-access security group and specific sources. carol, can you confirm your SSH public key is uploaded to your profile? if not, do `ssh-copy-id -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub carol@bastion.redwood.internal` (if allowed) or paste the key into the onboarding form. i'll check the SG and add you if needed.

it-support: opened ticket IT-2026 to add carol to `internal-access` and verify bastion ACLs: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IT-2026 — ETA ~30m.

carol: added the route as advised (`sudo route -n add -net 10.25.0.0/16 10.8.0.1` with my utun ip) — ping works and `ssh carol@bastion.redwood.internal` connects now. thanks!! :raised_hands:

marina: awesome, welcome again :slightly_smiling_face: i'll update the onboarding VPN doc (docs/onboarding/vpn.md) with Pulse screenshots and the split-tunnel troubleshooting steps. if you hit authorization errors after the ticket, i'll follow up. ping us anytime.
